historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as an auto showroom. The building held auto showrooms, used-car salesrooms, an auto body building shop and auto supplies and tire shops. Modern grilles now cover its large window openings.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 3CS — individually eligible for the California Register, under Criterion 1.
